units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 6:2:2">Y. Dem. VI, 25ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>א׳ לית לון א׳ לית לסתמא</he> we do not recognize an interpretation (of an agreement, so as to say, <he>נעשה כאומר וכ׳</he> ‘it means as though they had said—’); no qualification is admissible for an unqualified agreement.
